pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with varying spatial area. Edges exhibit soft pixel gradients and low angularity, primarily sub-rounded to sub-angular geometries on the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways with variable pixel thickness. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radiate and tetra-radiate intersections.
